title: Video Editor Wanted, Long-Term Full-Time Role
description:
**Video Editor Wanted, Long-Term Full-Time Role**



We are a US marketing agency that produces short-form video content for professional service clients, posted across many social media platforms with localized captions.



We are looking for someone meticulous and reliable to join our team. The work has good rhythm to it: clear systems, clear templates, clear expectations. Once you learn our process, you settle into it and the days flow.



**The work:**



- Editing short-form videos in CapCut from source footage

- Working with Submagic for captioning workflows

- Posting finished videos to social media platforms (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts,
, LinkedIn, and others)

- Following our templates and process carefully

- Learning additional tools as our system grows



The individual tasks are not technically difficult. We are not doing complex color grading, motion graphics, or Premiere/After Effects work. If you know CapCut, you can do the editing.



What we care about most is attention to detail. Every video represents a real client, and we want each one to look right. The kind of person who thrives here is the kind who notices small things and takes pride in catching them.



**What we offer:**



- Stable full-time salaried position, paid on time in USD every month

- Long-term role, we want someone who will stay for years

- Training from our senior tea
mber who already runs this workflow

- Clear systems and templates so you are not figuring things out alone

- A friendly, low-drama team

- Room to grow into more responsibility over time



**Who we're looking for:**



- Strong English, written and spoken

- Meticulous attention to detail

- Working knowledge of CapCut, ideally also Submagic

- Willing to learn new tools and platforms as needed

- Reliable internet, backup power, quiet workspace

- Available 3 to 4 hours of overlap with US Pacific Time daily (approximately 11 PM to 3 AM Philippine time)

- Coachable, humble, takes feedback well

- Enjoys doing good work consistently



**To apply, please include:**



1. A short paragraph about your editing experience

2. A link to a video you've edited (any platform)

3. Your expected monthly salary in USD

4. Tell us about a time you caught a mistake in your own work before it shipped, what it was and how you noticed it



The last question matters most. We are hiring for the kind of mind that notices things.



Applications missing any of these four items will not be considered. We read every complete application carefully.

title: Data Analyst, Returns and Credits
description:
We are looking for a highly technical and analytical Data Analyst to own the data integrity of our returns and credits department. Your primary goal is ensuring that our refunds and credits are reported accurately, formatted correctly, and tracked meticulously. 

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

• Data Integrity & Auditing: Monitor the full lifecycle of refunds and credits to ensure all data is updated, formatted correctly, and reported without errors. 

• SLA Tracking & Analysis: Build and maintain tracking systems for vendor performance to identify which refunds, credits, and returns are on time versus pending. 

• Reporting & Insights: Generate daily reports that identify backlogs and discrepancies for the operational teams to address. 

• Scripting & Automation: Utilize scripts (Python, VBA, or AI-generated code) to clean messy data, run complex audits, and automate manual reporting processes. 

• Financial Reconciliation: Work with accounting values to ensure that internal system data matches the financial reality of bank and credit memos. 

________________________________________

The Ideal Candidate

• Analytical & Technical: You spend 95% of your time in the data and are an expert in Excel. 

• Detail-Obsessed: You spot formatting errors and missing values immediately. 

• Resourceful: You know how to use tools, including AI, to write the scripts or formulas needed to get the job done efficiently. 

• Comfortable with Large Datasets: You are proficient in using scripts to manipulate and clean significant volumes of information. 

________________________________________

Requirements

• Excel Proficiency: High-level mastery of complex formulas, PivotTables, and VBA/Macros. 

• Scripting/Automation: Experience using Python, SQL, or similar tools to process data. 

• AI Literacy: While you do not need to be a developer, you must be comfortable using AI to create scripts and understand how to run them. 

• Financial Data Background: Experience working with accounting values, financial data, or inventory reconciliation. 

• Organization: Proven ability to organize data workflows and track Service Level Agreements (SLAs). 

________________________________________

***IMPORTANT***

Please send in your CV or a link to a shared file with the necessary access granted. Note: Applications submitted without a CV will be ignored.

We are looking for a highly organised, professional and proactive Operations Manager to become a key part of our team and help manage the day-to-day running of the business.



This is a fast-paced role that requires excellent communication skills, strong problem-solving ability and the confidence to handle schools, coaches and operational issues professionally and efficiently.



---



# Key Responsibilities



* Managing incoming calls and
s from schools, parents and coaches

title: Bookkeeper / Accountant  – Permanent Full Time
description:
# Remote Bookkeeper — Full-Time



We're hiring a full-time remote bookkeeper to run project invoicing, payments, and reconciliation in QuickBooks Online. Accuracy and consistency are the entire job.



---



## The kind of bookkeeping



This is project-based B2B bookkeeping. Customer payments come in two stages — typically 50?posit at order, balance before delivery. Supplier payments mirror that structure where required (deposit to start production, balance once production is complete). Some suppliers are on net 30 terms; every bill is PO-driven. The business operates between Canada and the US.



If your background is SaaS, retail, or subscription bookkeeping, this is a different rhythm — closer to construction, manufacturing, or project-based services.



---



## Compensation & Hours



- **Full-time, 40 hours/week**

- Hourly rate: **$5–10/hr** depending on experience

- Permanent role



---



## What you'll do



**Project invoicing (QBO)**

When a customer pays a deposit or design fee, trigger the project sequence: create the Project under the customer using the next sequential project code, move the Estimate into the Project, convert it to an Invoice, and record the payment. Apply every payment to the correct invoice and project.



**Accounts Payable**

- Match every supplier bill to its PO before entering in QBO

- Create payment orders in RBC PayEdge — COO approves before they go out

- Time supplier final payments correctly: the customer's final payment must clear before the supplier's balance is paid



**Contractors**

- Reconcile contractor invoices against Time Doctor hours before payment

- Pay contractors on schedule



**Accounts Receivable**

- Collect customer payments and follow up on outstanding balances

- Track every receipt to the correct invoice and project



**Communication**

- Monitor finance-related from customers, suppliers, and the internal team

- Coordinate with the team in Slack — no silent backlogs

- Email customers and suppliers





---



## Tools



QuickBooks Online, RBC PayEdge, Time Doctor, Slack, Asana, Excel / Google Sheets.



---



## What "good" looks like



- Zero unapplied payments. Zero duplicate customer records. Zero sloppy project coding.

- Every supplier bill matched to a PO before payment.

- Every supplier final balance paid only after the customer's payment has cleared.

- Audit trail clean enough that anyone can open a project and understand what happened.

- Asana tasks moved as work progresses — never silent for days.



---



## Requirements



- Proven QuickBooks Online experience (Projects, Estimates, Invoices, Bills, POs)

- Strong accounts payable discipline (PO matching, bill creation, payment recording)

- Strong written English and clear communication

- High attention to detail — you catch mismatched totals and missed steps before anyone else does

- Comfortable working inside documented SOPs and Asana-driven workflows — you follow the process and flag deviations rather than freelancing

- Strong preference for experience with deposit-based project billing, supplier net terms, and cross-border (Canada/US) operations

- Ecommerce bookkeeping experience is an asset, not a requirement



---



## Schedule



- Remote

- Full-time, Monday to Friday

- Minimum 4 hours of daily overlap with 9am–5pm Eastern Time



---



## To apply



In your intro message, include:



1. Expected hourly rate and years of QBO experience

2. Availability in Eastern Time

3. Resume

title: SOCIAL MEDIA + CONTENT COORDINATOR
description:
I’m looking for someone organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and visually creative to help manage and move forward my social media content across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



This role is a mix of:

– content coordination

– posting/scheduling

– communication with editors

– tracking deliverables

– and helping keep the content pipeline organized and moving consistently.



This is not a high-level strategy role.

It is primarily an execution and coordination role.



What You’ll Do

– Schedule and publish content

– Coordinate with video editors

– Track content status and deadlines

– Follow up on delayed edits or missing assets

– Help organize content ideas and posting flow

– Keep a simple content calendar updated

– Make sure content consistently moves forward each week



What I’m Looking For

– Organized and detail-oriented

– Responsive and reliable

– Comfortable managing multiple moving pieces

– Good communication skills

– Familiar with Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

– Able to follow through without needing constant reminders

– Strong aesthetic eye and modern visual taste

– Able to recognize clean, emotionally engaging, high-quality content and visuals



Bonus If You Have

– Experience with creators, coaches, podcasts, or personal brands

– Experience using Canva, Notion, Google Drive, Later, Airtable, etc.

– Basic understanding of social media growth/content flow

– Editing or design experience



Daily Communication

At the end of each day, I’d like a simple update:

– what was completed

– what is still in progress

– any blockers or delays

– what is next



Compensation

– $5/hour

– Part-time to start with potential for growth over time based on performance and consistency



Application Requirements

Please send:

1. Your resume

2. A short intro video (1–2 minutes)

3. Examples of social media accounts, edits, or content you’ve worked on

4. Portfolio/examples that show your visual taste and aesthetic eye

5. Your time-zone and availability



If shortlisted, there will be a short paid trial project.



This is a long-term role for someone who is organized, communicative, creative, and enjoys helping content move consistently and smoothly.



I will not be reviewing applications here. Please send your resume, portfolio, and a thoughtful cover letter to amina [at] zamanicoachinggroup [dot] com. Only complete applications will be considered.



Use the exact subject line:

Social Media Person Application – [Full Name] – [Years of Experience]

title: Amazon PPC Specialist (Part-Time)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Amazon PPC Specialist to support our growing Amazon Private Label brands. This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, detail-oriented, and highly experienced in managing and optimizing PPC campaigns.



Your main focus will be improving ad performance, reducing ACoS, scaling profitable campaigns, and driving overall sales through effective advertising strategies.



Work Schedule



* Philippine Time

* Part-time – 4 hours per day

* 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM (with 1-hour break from 12:00–1:00 PM)



Compensation



* Starting rate: $3/hour

* Increase to $4/hour after probation (based on performance and KPI evaluation)



Key Responsibilities



* Set up, manage, and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display)

* Perform keyword research and build effective campaign structures

* Analyze search term reports and optimize targeting

* Adjust bids, budgets, and placements based on performance

* Scale profitable campaigns and control ACoS/TACoS

* Conduct competitor and market analysis

* Monitor daily campaign performance and key metrics

* Provide actionable insights and optimization suggestions

* Coordinate tasks and updates via Asana

* Track time using Clockify



Required Experience



* At least 6 months of hands-on Amazon PPC experience

* Proven experience managing Private Label PPC campaigns

* Strong understanding of ACoS, TACoS, CTR, CVR, and campaign scaling strategies

* Ability to analyze data and make performance-driven decisions

* Experience handling multiple campaigns/accounts



Additional Skills (Plus)



* Experience in listing creation

* Ability to perform keyword research and incorporate it into optimized listing content (titles, bullets, backend search terms)

* Knowledge of how to publish listings on Amazon while following Amazon policies and guidelines



Tools You Must Be Familiar With



* Amazon Campaign Manager

* Helium 10 (or similar keyword tools)

* Keepa

* Google Sheets / Docs

* Asana

* Clockify



We’re Looking For Someone Who Is



* Data-driven and analytical

* Detail-oriented and organized

* Proactive in identifying opportunities for optimization

* Consistent and reliable with daily monitoring

* Comfortable working with SOPs and workflows



To Apply



Please include:



1. Your Amazon PPC experience

2. Campaigns or brands you’ve managed

3. Tools you’ve used

4. Your OLJ subject line: PL-PPC-4HRS

title: Full-Stack Developer – AI SaaS Platforms (React / Node.js / OpenAI)
description:
About the Role



We are a Sydney-based software development agency looking for a skilled full-stack developer to take end-to-end ownership of AI-powered SaaS platforms we are building for clients. You will be working across AI projects including multi-provider orchestration pipelines, RAG-based content generation, programmatic document processing, and full multi-tenant SaaS builds. Detailed specifications are ready to go. You will be the primary developer, working directly with our technical lead and project manager.



This is a remote, exclusive role. You must be available during Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST/AEDT) business hours.



The Work



You will be building full SaaS applications from scratch using React 18, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and TypeScript. The projects are heavily AI-integrated and involve real technical complexity — this is not a CRUD app role.



AI Orchestration and Multi-Provider Pipelines

Work includes building custom orchestration layers that chain multiple AI providers in sequence (including OpenAI, Claude, and Perplexity). You will implement pipeline logic covering parallelism, retry strategies with exponential backoff, rate limit management across providers, and streaming responses via SSE.



RAG and Vector Store Architecture

Projects include work with the OpenAI Responses API, file_search, and managed vector stores to generate AI content grounded in client knowledge bases. The retrieval architecture uses a multi-store design separating shared expert knowledge from per-client and per-job data — shaped by the two-vector-store-per-call constraint on the Responses API. You will build setup scripts, sync logic, metadata filtering, and the full generation pipeline.



Document Processing and Assembly

Work includes parsing uploaded PDF and DOCX files using Azure Document Intelligence to extract questions, tables, and document structure, then mapping AI-generated content back into the original document format without breaking layout or formatting. This is among the most technically demanding work in the engagement and a key competitive differentiator for our clients.



SaaS Platform Features

Projects involve full multi-tenant SaaS applications including user authentication, subscription billing via Stripe and/or Chargebee (webhooks, billing portal, feature gating by tier), knowledge base management, file uploads, admin portals, and health check engines.



What You Will Be Doing



Building AI-powered SaaS platforms end-to-end from detailed functional and technical specifications

Implementing multi-provider AI orchestration pipelines with parallelism, retry logic, and rate limit management

Setting up and managing OpenAI vector stores: file sync scripts, metadata attributes, multi-store retrieval architecture

Solving document mapping challenges: parsing input documents with Azure Document Intelligence and assembling correctly formatted DOCX outputs from AI-generated content

Building full SaaS platform features: auth, subscription billing, multi-tenancy, feature gating, file uploads, admin workflows

Writing production-quality, well-typed TypeScript across frontend and backend

Reading and building from specification documents — raising questions where specs are ambiguous or incomplete

Participating in standups, providing regular progress updates, and communicating blockers early



Requirements



Must Have



5+ years of professional full-stack development with React and Node.js as your primary stack

Strong TypeScript across frontend and backend — comfortable with type inference, generics, and type-safe ORM usage

PostgreSQL with a modern ORM (Drizzle preferred, Prisma acceptable) — schema design, migrations, query optimisation

Solid third-party API integration experience — authentication, webhooks, error handling

OpenAI API experience, ideally the Responses API, file_search, and vector store management; if not, you must be a fast learner from documentation

Azure Document Intelligence

Experience parsing or generating documents programmatically (PDF, DOCX) — extracting structured data from unstructured sources or producing formatted output from code

Stripe integration experience — subscription billing, webhooks, billing portal

Ability to work independently from detailed specifications without needing hand-holding on every decision



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



A brief summary of your relevant experience, specifically addressing the AI and document processing requirements

A PDF or Google Doc link to your CV — applications without a CV will not be considered

Links to projects or repositories that demonstrate your full-stack work (GitHub, portfolio, or live projects)

Confirmation that you are: OK with screenshot capture software for time tracking; available during Sydney (AEST/AEDT) business hours; happy in an exclusive role with no paid or unpaid freelance work on the side; and willing to undergo a live technical assessment as part of the interview process

title: Amazon Operations Manager
description:
We're hiring an Amazon Operations Manager. The kind of person who can take the entire Amazon side of a growing brand off the founder's plate and run it like it's theirs.



You'll own the platform end-to-end across our key marketplaces (US, CA, MX, UK, AU, JP). Every listing, every metric, every routine, every deal. You'll cross-check our supply chain. You'll spend roughly one day a week building AI agents and automations that make the function leaner over time. And you'll have full access to Claude and whatever comes next.



This isn't a coordinator role. It's an operator role. If you've already run Amazon ops for a brand at real scale and you want more autonomy, smarter tools, and a founder who'll get out of your way once you've earned it, read on.





YOU SHOULD APPLY IF



You've personally run an Amazon ops function before for a brand doing meaningful volume — owning the operation, not just executing tasks within someone else's

You've run Amazon ops across multiple international marketplaces (not just the US). You understand the quirks of each: VAT, regional compliance, marketplace-specific listing rules, marketplace-specific image uploads, global review sharing etc.

You're AI-fluent. You actively use Claude or similar in your daily work, you're comfortable with agentic workflows, and you can build and refine prompts. Having built automations is a bonus, not required.

You're a natural systems thinker. When you describe past work, you talk in workflows, inputs, decisions, and edge cases

You have deep working knowledge of Seller Central — listings, GTINs, barcodes, FNSKUs, A+ content, brand stores, account health, deals and promotions setup

You're a process person. You believe in checklists, SOPs, and consistent routines

Your written and spoken English is excellent



DON'T APPLY IF



You've only been a coordinator, specialist, or VA on someone else's Amazon team

Your Amazon experience is limited to the US marketplace

You treat AI as "something to dabble with" rather than core to how you work

You can't sit comfortably with routine work. Most days, this job is steady, methodical, and detail-heavy

You need a manager looking over your shoulder to do good work



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Run the platform



Daily, weekly, and monthly operational routines across our marketplaces

Listing maintenance: sizes, secondary images, A+ content, product videos, brand stores

GTIN allocation, barcode setup (FNSKU/UPC/EAN), and resolving barcode failures

Account health monitoring. Keep every dashboard green

Shipment defect resolution. Work the Inbound Performance Dashboard, assess each case, d
 whether to dispute or acknowledge, follow through



Run the marketing execution layer



Set up and run all deals, Brand Tailored Promotions, coupons, tiered discounts, and bundles in Seller Central

Maintain strikethrough pricing on priority ASINs and recover it when it drops off

Audit multi-marketplace pricing consistency — make sure prices land cleanly across all marketplaces after Marketing sets them

Monitor KW rank and conversion rate on priority ASINs; flag anomalies, execute the agreed fix

Keep marketing and supply informed when a deal, badge, or campaign is driving unusual sales activity



Cross-check the supply chain



Act as a sounding board and second pair of eyes on our Supply Manager's forecasting, POs, and shipping plans before they reach the founder

Build deep enough understanding of the supply chain to flag risks she might miss and offer alternatives, not just rubber-stamp



Build and improve the function



Spend roughly one day per week building, deploying, and refining AI automations that reduce manual work across the function

Stay current with Amazon platform changes and bring them into the workflow

Refine routines, SOPs, and processes as the operation evolves

Bring ideas, process improvements, expansion opportunities, smarter ways of working



BONUS SKILLS (nice, not required)

Experience with Sellerboard, DataDive, Datarova or similar Amazon analytics tools

Background in consumer electronics or adjacent product categories

mber) as a cross-check on her work.

title: Urgent: Product Research & Sourcing Expert (Remote)
description:
At Orca Brands, we specialize in creating high-performance beauty and wellness tools designed to make a real impact. From advanced skincare to haircare technology, our products are backed by science and built for results. Sold both direct-to-consumer and via Amazon, our brand is trusted by women worldwide. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a strategic Product Research & Sourcing Expert with a marketing mindset to help us scale and innovate faster.



Job Summary

We’re seeking a Product Research & Sourcing Expert who is not only experienced in supplier and manufacturing coordination, but also has a strong grasp of brand positioning, consumer trends, and marketing strategy. In this role, you’ll work closely with cross-functional teams to source products and packaging that align with our Unique Selling Propositions (USPs) and meet evolving market demands.



Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

Product & R&D Timeline Management: Maintain an always-updated product development snapshot to monitor manufacturing status and proactively avoid delays.

Pretotyping & Trend Scouting: Collaborate with factories to explore new product categories and innovations that support product-market fit and deliver fresh USPs.

Quality Control Coordination: Ensure quality standards are met and sustained through consistent communication with suppliers and product testing.

Sourcing & Procurement: Identify and vet new suppliers, source competitive quotes, negotiate MOQ, pricing, and lead times.

Packaging & Brand Alignment: Source packaging that enhances brand perception and strengthens product USPs through aesthetics and functionality.

Spec Sheet & Tech Pack Oversight: Work with factories to maintain up-to-date product documentation, including part numbers, materials, and contract terms.

Cost Optimization: Track and manage per-part pricing and production efficiency without compromising quality or brand positioning.

Collaborate with Marketing: Work with product and marketing teams to ensure sourced products clearly communicate their value proposition and unique benefits.



Qualifications:

2–5 years experience in sourcing, preferably in beauty, wellness, or consumer electronics

Familiar with Chinese and Asian suppliers, Alibaba, 1688, and related platforms

Marketing background or strong understanding of product positioning and USP development

Experience working with DTC brands or Amazon sellers is a strong plus

Strong written and spoken English; Mandarin is a bonus

High attention to detail; process-driven and self-managed

Excellent communication, negotiation, and supplier relationship skills

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growth-focused environment



What We Offer:

Competitive salary – earn in USD

Health coverage (HMO) – after one year

Paid time off – we believe in work-life balance

Global exposure – work with a diverse and innovative team



Explore Our Brands

title: Controller / Bookkeeper (CPA Background) - Strict US PST Graveyard Shift
description:
Job Title: Controller / Bookkeeper (CPA Background) - Strict US PST Graveyard Shift

Compensation: $1,600 USD / Month (approx. 92,000 PHP)

Job Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)



Company Overview:

We are a growing US-based business We are seeking a highly analytical and experienced accounting professional based in the Philippines to manage our financial operations. This role requires a balance of high-level financial strategy and hands-on, daily bookkeeping execution.



Core Responsibilities:



Financial Management & Analysis: Oversee the month-end and year-end close processes. Prepare and analyze financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow), and provide actionable insights on financial trends, variances, and operational efficiencies.



Full-Cycle Bookkeeping: Accurately record and categorize daily financial transactions. Perform regular bank and credit card reconciliations to maintain pristine, audit-ready financial records.



Accounts Payable & Receivable: Manage billing cycles, generate invoices, and track incoming payments.



Communication: Serve as the primary financial point of contact for customer billing inquiries and communicate clearly in real-time with our US executive team via
 and chat.



Qualifications & Requirements:



Education & Experience: Active CPA license or equivalent degree in Finance/Accounting. Minimum of 3-5 years of proven experience in a Senior Bookkeeper, Financial Analyst, or Controller role.



Technical Proficiency: Advanced expertise in accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks Online, Xero) and Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets (Pivot Tables, advanced formulas).



Communication Skills: Excellent, highly professional written and verbal English communication skills suitable for client-facing interactions.



Work Schedule: Must be able to work a strict, dedicated US Pacific Standard Time schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST, which translates to 12:00 AM (Midnight) to 8:00 AM Philippine Standard Time (PHT), Monday through Friday.



To Apply:

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter detailing your relevant experience. To confirm your attention to detail, please state the US city where our company is located in the first sentence of your application.

title: Dispatch Operations Specialist
description:
AJG Transport (GH Logistics Affiliate) is a US based asset carrier operating 150+ company trucks on dedicated government contract freight. We run 365 days a year on consistent, contracted routes across 48 states. We're scaling fast with new markets, new lanes, new teams, and we need operators who can keep up.



This isn't a BPO. This isn't a call center. You'll be embedded in a real U.S. logistics operation working alongside American dispatchers, drivers, and carriers on live freight.



Role Overview

You're an operator working directly alongside our dispatch and freight management team, handling the higher complexity operational work that keeps our network running. Think of this as the role that handles what most people can't, the exceptions, the escalations, the details that make or break a load.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Book and coordinate loads across our network while ensuring proper carrier coverage, profitability, and operational efficiency. You own the load from booking through final delivery.

• Monitor and manage active loads across our network. Tracking, status updates, carrier and driver communication, and exception handling. You own the load from pickup to delivery.

• Verify data accuracy, documentation completeness, and process compliance across active loads. Catch problems before they become expensive.

• Conduct check calls, appointment scheduling, detention tracking, rate confirmations. You're the voice on the phone making sure freight moves on time.

• Respond to driver inquiries, route them to the right internal team, document issues. Drivers call with problems and you solve them or escalate them fast.

• Ensure accurate data on TMS for Loads, rates, stops, and documents. Everything in our systems needs to be accurate. You're the last line of defense before bad data creates bad decisions.

• Identify recurring issues, flag inefficiencies, and recommend fixes. We don't want someone who just follows a checklist. We want someone who makes the checklist better.

• Report daily and weekly ops summaries for US leadership.

• Know what you can solve vs. what needs to go up the chain, and route it fast. No sitting on problems.



Who We’re Looking For

• 2+ years experience in freight brokerage, dispatch, or logistics operations. NOT GENERAL VA WORK. We need someone who already knows what a BOL is, what detention means, and how a load moves from quote to delivery.

• Hands on experience with TMS platforms such as McLeod, Aljex, Turvo, or similar. If you've dispatched loads in a real system, we want to talk to you.

• Familiarity with load boards such as DAT, Truckstop, Highway or similar. You've sourced carriers or managed freight on these platforms before.

• Strong written and verbal English. You'll be on calls and email with US based drivers, carriers, and leadership daily. This is non negotiable.

• Night shift in PH availability — You'll work U.S. business hours. CST timezone alignment preferred (example: 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST/CDT = 8:00 PM – 6:00 AM PHT). 

• Self-directed. You don't wait to be told what to do. You see the problem, you fix it, you report it. If you need someone holding your hand, this isn't the role.



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: 7 AM – 5 PM CDT | 3 PM - 1 AM CDT | 11 PM - 9 AM CDT (San Antonio time)

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Possible Hubstaff time tracking during shifts, but is not currently in use.



What You'll Get

• $7/hr USD. Paid consistently biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Growth path. 90 day performance review with opportunity to advance into senior operations roles as we scale. We're growing fast and the people who prove themselves early get the best opportunities.

• Direct access to U.S. executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager in Manila. You work directly with our operations team in Texas and Tennessee.

• Real operations work. Live freight, real drivers, real carriers, real money on the line. This isn't data entry with a fancy title.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a U.S. freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former dispatchers or carrier reps who are tired of BPO environments

• Operators who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You run your loads like they are your business.

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
We are a fast-growing streetwear brand based in Germany, 

selling clothing to a style-conscious audience across Europe. We are a lean, founder-led brand 

doing six-figure revenue with thousands of loyal customers — and we are 

now hiring our first dedicated customer support person.



We ship worldwide but our main market is Europe — mostly Germany, 

UK, Scandinavia, and the rest of the EU. Our customers are young, 

passionate about what they wear, and they expect fast, human replies 

when they reach out.



???????????????????????????????



?? REQUIREMENTS — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



You MUST have worked for at least 3 e-commerce or dropshipping stores 

before. This is non-negotiable. In your application, list every 

e-commerce brand you have worked for and briefly describe your role 

at each one. Applications without this will not be considered.



???????????????????????????????



HOW THE WORK ACTUALLY LOOKS



Let me be real about what this job is:



Every customer reply is written by our AI chatbot. You are not 

writing
s from scratch. The workflow is:



1. Read the incoming customer message

2. Paste it into our AI chatbot with the relevant context and instrucitons

3. The chatbot generates the reply

4. You review it — does it make sense? Is the policy correct? 

   Does the tone feel right?

5. Copy-paste and send



That's the core of it. It is a copy-paste job with judgment.



The judgment part is what matters. The AI can sometimes produce 

wrong answers, miss context, or apply the wrong policy. You need 

to understand enough about our system to catch that. You don't 

need to be a native English writer — you need to understand 

English well enough to read a customer's message, know what 

they actually want, and recognize whether the AI's reply is 

correct or off.



You also need to know when to NOT use the chatbot and flag 

the case directly to me instead.



This requires common sense, basic understanding of e-commerce 

support, and the ability to work independently without someone 

holding your hand after the onboarding phase.



???????????????????????????????



HOW ONBOARDING WORKS



We don't throw you into the deep end. Onboarding is fast, structured, 

and fully paid from day one.



- 2 Google Meet sessions where I personally walk you through every 

  common case type, our policies, our tone, and our tools

- You get full documentation with templates and clear rules for 

  every situation you will encounter

- You get direct WhatsApp access to me (the founder). Any question, 

  any time — just ask. I respond fast and I don't bite

- In the first weeks, I review your replies and give you direct 

  feedback so you build real understanding



The onboarding takes about 2 days. After that, you handle the inbox 

with my support in the background. As your confidence grows, you gain 

full autonomy.



???????????????????????????????



WHAT YOU HANDLE DAY-TO-DAY



Most of the work is common, recurring customer questions:



- "Where is my package?" — shipping status and tracking

- "I want to return my order" — return and refund requests

- "I haven't received my order yet" — missing parcel cases

- "Is my order a pre-order?" — order status clarification

- "My item arrived damaged" — product issue reports



These make up 90% of the inbox. Clear documentation and templates 

exist for all of them. For anything unusual — legal threats, 

chargebacks, policy exceptions — you flag it directly to me. 

You will never be left alone on a difficult case.



???????????????????????????????



THIS JOB IS NOT



- A call center. No phone calls, ever.

- Cold outreach or sales.

- Social media management or content creation.

- A job where you need to write anything from scratch.



It is structured inbox management with a clear system behind it. 

You paste, you review, you send. But you need the understanding 

to do it right.

You are conducting structured verification meetings, reviewing compliance documents, walking contractors through service contracts front to back, and making the final approve or deny decision before a building gets assigned.

Important Note:

This role operates within a strict SOP framework. Every stage change, date field, and note must be completed at the time of the event — no exceptions. Incomplete tickets delay the entire changeover process and directly impact client service.

title: WordPress Developer & SEO / AEO Specialist — Environmental Consulting Website
description:
OVERVIEW OF POSITION:

Lumen Environmental Sciences

Part Time (with transition to ongoing monthly retainer after launch)

20–30 hours/week during build phase (approximately 6–10 weeks), 10–15 hours/week ongoing after launch

Build Phase: $900–$1,500 USD (fixed project fee, paid in milestones) Ongoing Retainer (post-launch): $350–$550 USD/month

(Exact rate dependent on experience and portfolio — open to discussion)



Job Description



THIS IS A TWO-PHASE ENGAGEMENT

Phase 1 is a fixed-fee website build project. Phase 2 is an ongoing monthly SEO / AEO / maintenance retainer. We are looking for one person to handle both phases long-term. If you are only interested in the build or only interested in ongoing SEO, this is not the right fit.



ABOUT THIS PROJECT

Lumen Environmental Sciences is an independent environmental testing and consulting firm based in Phoenix, Arizona. We provide asbestos surveys, mold testing, lead testing, indoor air quality assessments, and 15+ additional environmental testing services across Arizona.

We are building a professional, high-performance WordPress website from scratch and need a skilled, detail-oriented developer who can also manage ongoing SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) after launch.

A detailed written build brief will be provided to qualified candidates after a confidentiality agreement is signed. The brief covers every page, every section, copy direction, technical requirements, schema strategy, CRM integration, and a complete pre-launch checklist. You will not be guessing. Everything is documented.

This is a long-term opportunity for the right person. If you build the site well and understand how to grow organic presence in competitive local service markets, we want to keep you on retainer.



PHASE 1 — WEBSITE BUILD (Fixed-Fee Project)

Platform & Hosting:



WordPress on managed hosting (WP Engine, Kinsta, or Flywheel — your recommendation welcome)

Staging environment required before any live deployment

SSL, CDN, PHP 8.1+, automatic daily backups configured and tested



Pages to Build:

19 service pages including: Asbestos Surveys, Mold Testing, Lead Testing, Silica Testing, VOC / Indoor Air Quality, and 14 additional service pages.

Supporting pages including: Homepage, About, Contact, Emergency Services, Pricing / How It Works, Sample Reports, Contractor Partner Program, Lead Magnet /
 Capture, Insurance & Carrier Partners, Blog, Accessibility Statement, HTML Sitemap, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Custom 404, and Thank You page.

Technical Requirements:



Schema markup on every page — LocalBusiness, Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, WebPage

llms.txt file published at root domain (AEO/GEO requirement)

XML sitemap generated, verified, and submitted to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools

robots.txt verified — no service pages, schema, or sitemap blocked

Canonical tags on all pages

Open Graph tags on all pages

Meta titles and descriptions written and reviewed before launch

Image alt text completed on all images

Core Web Vitals reviewed — mobile load time under 3 seconds (Google PageSpeed Insights)

WCAG 2.1 AA compliance — Lighthouse Accessibility score 90+

GA4 installed with conversion event configured on Thank You page

Google Search Console connected and verified

CallRail (or equivalent) installed, integrated with GA4 and CRM — call events firing as conversions

CRM integration (GoHighLevel or equivalent) — all form submissions must map to correct CRM fields and trigger automation workflows



CRM Automation Workflows (5 total — full specs provided in brief):



New Quote Request intake and notification

Emergency Service Request intake and dispatch

Lead Magnet download + automated
 nurture sequence

Post-project review request automation

Contractor Partner application intake and acknowledgment





PHASE 2 — ONGOING SEO / AEO / GEO (Monthly Retainer After Launch)

After a successful launch, we want the same person managing ongoing organic growth. This is not basic blog posting. We need someone who understands how to build topical authority, optimize for Google AI Overview placement, and help an entity get recognized by LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.

Monthly Ongoing Tasks:



Minimum 2 blog posts per month (content briefs provided; you write and publish)

Google Search Console review monthly — flag issues and opportunities, report to principal

Schema validation check quarterly

Core Web Vitals review quarterly

Google Business Profile maintenance — photos, hours, review response coordination

Citation building — Google, Bing Places, Apple Maps, LinkedIn, AIHA, BBB, and industry-specific directories

WordPress core and plugin updates weekly

Backup verification weekly

Uptime monitoring with alert notifications

Monthly summary report — traffic, rankings, technical health



AEO / GEO Focus:

We want to rank not just in Google but in AI answer engines. This means building proper entity recognition, consistent structured data, a well-maintained llms.txt, and topical authority across all 19 service categories. If you do not know what AEO or GEO means, please do not apply.



COMMUNICATION & AVAILABILITY

You must be available for at least 2–3 overlapping hours per week during US Mountain Time business hours for check-ins via video call or messaging. Async communication is the norm. Responsiveness within 24 hours on business days is required.



OWNERSHIP & CONFIDENTIALITY

All work product, code, content, design assets, and configurations produced for this project are the exclusive property of Lumen Environmental Sciences upon delivery and payment.

Finalists will be asked to sign a confidentiality agreement before receiving the full project brief.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

To be considered, please answer all seven questions below. Generic applications without portfolio links or answers to these questions will not be reviewed.



Portfolio — Share links to WordPress sites you have built, ideally for service-based businesses or professional firms.



SEO Experience — Briefly describe your SEO approach for a local professional service business. 



What do you prioritize in the first 90 days after launch? 



Please include at least one Google Search Console screenshot or ranking result showing measurable organic growth for a client site you have managed.



AEO / GEO Familiarity — Have you worked on AEO or GEO strategy? 



What is an llms.txt file and why does it matter? 



Even basic familiarity is fine — we will guide on specifics — but do not claim experience you do not have.



Schema Experience — Have you implemented LocalBusiness, Service, and FAQPage schema? 



What tool or method do you use?



CRM Integration Experience — Have you connected WordPress forms to a CRM? 



Which CRM platforms have you worked with?



Rate — Provide your proposed fixed project fee for the build phase AND your proposed monthly retainer rate for ongoing SEO and maintenance.



Availability — How many hours per week can you commit during the build phase, and what is your realistic timeline to complete a project of this scope?



FINALIST PROCESS

Qualified candidates who advance to finalist stage will be asked to complete a brief paid skills test of approximately 1–2 hours before a project agreement is signed. This will be compensated at an agreed hourly rate.



WHAT MAKES A STRONG CANDIDATE



You have built professional service websites on WordPress — not just simple blogs or basic templates

You understand on-page SEO, technical SEO, local SEO, and schema markup — not just keyword research

You are familiar with or willing to learn AEO/GEO best practices — AI Overview optimization, entity recognition, llms.txt

You are detail-oriented — our build brief is thorough and you will be expected to follow it carefully

You communicate clearly, ask good questions, and provide status updates without being chased

You are comfortable working independently from a detailed written brief

You are honest about what you can and cannot do — we would rather hire someone with a realistic scope than someone who overpromises





WHAT THIS IS NOT



This is not a quick-flip project. The site is complex and detailed.

This is not a one-time engagement. We are looking for someone to grow with us long-term.

This is not a fit if you plan to use a page builder with no understanding of technical SEO, schema, or site performance.

This is not a fit if you cannot meet the communication and availability expectations above.





TO APPLY

Please respond with the subject line: Lumen Website — [Your Name]

Include your answers to all seven questions listed above. We will respond to qualified candidates within a few business days.

title: Remote Recruiter — Direct Care Staff Hiring
description:
Why This Role Matters



Nestvillage operates group homes in Arizona that care for adults with developmental disabilities. The people we hire — direct care workers — quite literally shape the daily lives of our residents. Bad hires cause real harm. Slow hiring leaves homes understaffed.

We need a recruiter who treats this like the high-stakes, high-volume operation it is: 20 - 30 direct care staff hires per month, every month, without dropping quality. You will own the entire pipeline — from job-board listing to first day on the floor — and you will be measured on speed, fill rate, and 90-day retention of the people you hire.



About Nestvillage



We are a small, fast-growing company in Sun City, Arizona providing residential care for adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD). We are mission-driven, family-run, and serious about building a workforce that reflects the care our residents deserve. This is our first dedicated recruiting hire — you will help build the function from the ground up.



What You’ll Own



You run the full recruiting cycle for direct care workers across all Nestvillage locations. End to end. No hand-offs.



Sourcing: Post and refresh listings on Indeed, ZipRecruiter, Glassdoor,
 Jobs, Craigslist, and IDD/healthcare niche boards. Run direct outreach in
 groups, community forums, and any other channel that produces applicants.



Screening: Review applications same-day. Conduct phone and video screens to assess fit for shift work, values alignment with IDD care, basic English, reliability, and red flags. Move qualified candidates forward within 24 hours.



Interviewing: Run structured interviews independently. Make hiring recommendations. Loop in the hiring manager only when needed — your judgment is trusted.



Pre-employment clearance: Coordinate fingerprinting, background checks, reference checks, drug screens, TB tests, CPR/First Aid, Article 9, Prevention & Support, and DCW certification. Track every requirement in the ATS until the candidate is cleared.



Onboarding handoff: Get new hires through paperwork, I-9, direct deposit, required training modules, and scheduled start date — fast. Hand them off to operations clean and ready to work.



Pipeline management: Maintain a live applicant pipeline in our ATS. Every candidate has a current status. Nothing falls through.



Reporting: Send a weekly report: applications received, screens completed, offers extended, hires closed, time-to-fill, and any blockers. We will set KPI targets together in your first week.



Process improvement: Test new sourcing channels. Improve screening questions. Cut time-to-fill quarter over quarter.



What Success Looks Like



We will measure performance, not hours. Concrete targets:



 20-30 direct care staff hires closed per month, sustained

 Time-to-fill under 14 days from application to first shift

 90-day retention of your hires above 70%

 Same-day response to every qualified applicant

 Zero open requisitions stalled more than 7 days without action



Must-Have Qualifications



1+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably in high-volume, hourly, or shift-based hiring (healthcare, home care, hospitality, BPO, or similar).



Excellent written and spoken English. You will be calling American applicants daily — they need to understand you clearly and trust you immediately.



Proven ability to work U.S. business hours. Minimum 6 hours of daily overlap with 8 AM – 5 PM Arizona time (MST/UTC?7).



Reliable high-speed internet (25+ Mbps), backup power or a backup workspace, a quiet professional environment for calls, and a working headset and webcam.



Comfort with ATS, spreadsheets, video calls, and cloud tools. You should not need hand-holding through Google Workspace, Zoom, or a basic applicant tracker.



Self-directed and organized. We will not micromanage. We will measure outcomes.



Mission alignment. You need to actually care that the people you place are going to support vulnerable adults. We screen for this.



Nice to Have



Experience recruiting for IDD, group homes, home health, assisted living, or similar care settings



Familiarity with U.S. caregiver licensing (DCW, Article 9, Fingerprint Clearance Card, CPR/First Aid)



Working knowledge of BambooHR, Connecteam, Indeed Employer, ZipRecruiter, Relias, or Google Workspace



Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, Psychology, or a related field



Experience building SOPs or training other recruiters



Tools You’ll Use



 ATS / HRIS: BambooHR (or our next ATS — we are evaluating)

 Communications: Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets), Zoom or Google Meet, Slack

 Phone: Google Voice or RingCentral (we provide a U.S. number)

 Job boards: Indeed, ZipRecruiter,
, Craigslist, IDD-specific boards

 Onboarding & training: Relias, Connecteam



Schedule & Work Setup



  Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday – Friday

  Core hours: minimum 6 hours of overlap with 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Arizona time (MST, UTC?7, year-round, no daylight saving)

  100% remote. We provide cloud tools, a U.S. phone number, and
. You provide the workspace, computer, internet, and    backup power.

  Paid time off and holidays will be defined in your offer letter



Compensation



USD $750-$1,500 per month for full-time, depending on experience and proven high-volume recruiting outcomes. Paid monthly via Wise or Payoneer. Performance bonuses available based on monthly hire targets and 90-day retention.



Growth Path



This is the first dedicated recruiting role at Nestvillage. As we grow, this seat grows with us:

Senior Recruiter / Lead Recruiter — taking ownership of sourcing strategy, employer brand, and recruiting metrics

Recruiting Manager — building and managing a small team of recruiters as we open more homes

Talent Operations Lead — owning onboarding, retention programs, and recruiting tech stack

We invest in training, certifications, and tools that make you better at your job.

 Tools You’ll Be Working With

We don't need someone to post jobs. We need someone to own the pipeline.



At Flourish Home Care, caregivers are the business. Every client we serve, every family we support, every hour of care we deliver — it all starts with one thing: finding the right people fast and keeping that pipeline full.



The Caregiver Recruiting Specialist is a full-time, fully remote role. You report directly to the CEO. There is no team above you on recruiting — you run it. WHAT THIS ROLE IS

You are the gatekeeper for every caregiver who comes through this agency. From the 
nt a job ad goes live to the 
nt a qualified candidate is passed to the hiring decision-maker — that entire journey is yours.

You source. You screen. You track. You follow up. You report. And you do all of it consistently, proactively, and without being told twice.





The Goal

The CEO never has to think about recruiting again. A pre-qualified, fully documented bench of motivated candidates is always ready to advance to the final interview.

Send the CEO a daily pipeline update: screened, advancing, stalled, and dropped



WEEKLY / ONGOING (SECONDARY)

Generate weekly reports on job ad performance, applicant volume, and stage conversion

Manage recruiting platform records and ensure clean handoff to onboarding software

Source candidates proactively through social media and community channels — not just inbound

Research new sourcing channels and bring recommendations before you're asked



MONTHLY (STRATEGIC)

Analyze recruiting data to identify funnel drop-off points and recommend adjustments

Prepare a monthly recruiting summary with trend observations and proposed changes for CEO review



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - TIMELINE



HOW YOU'LL KNOW WHAT THAT LOOKS LIKE IN PRACTICE



First 90 Days

CEO stops asking where the pipeline stands — because you're already telling them.

Every application gets same-day action. Records are clean. Candidates hear from us before they move on.



Months 4–9

Hiring needs visible 2–4 weeks out — not a surprise when someone gives notice.

Job ads are tested and improved, not just recycled. Pipeline reports arrive before they're requested.



Year 1+

CEO attends the final interview and nothing else.

The process runs because you built it to run — and it doesn't break when things get busy.





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR





NON-NEGOTIABLES

Excellent English — written and spoken. Candidates form their first impression of this company through your words. This is not flexible.

Tech-forward and comfortable managing multiple platforms, ATS tools, and digital workflows simultaneously

Practical experience using AI tools to move faster and produce better output — not as a crutch, as a skill

Detail-obsessed. Applicant records, follow-up timing, and pipeline accuracy aren't things you sometimes do. They're things you always do.

Experience in recruiting, HR coordination, talent sourcing, or a high-volume people-focused role

Home care or healthcare recruiting background — you'll move faster if you have it

Familiarity with applicant tracking systems or caregiver-specific platforms

Experience working with a U.S.-based employer in a fully remote contractor capacity



THE MINDSET WE HIRE FOR

ATTRIBUTE

WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE IN PRACTICE

Extreme Ownership

When something falls through the cracks, you own it. No excuses — just a fix and a plan to prevent it next time.

You connect with candidates professionally and warmly without letting empathy override screening standards.

"I sent the
" counts as a follow-up to you

title: Project Manager / Operations Coordinator
description:
Project Manager / Operations Coordinator — Multi-Business Creative Studio (Part-Time, Remote) (looking for a very long term commitment)



Hours: ~5 hours/week, with the option to grow if the fit is right

Pay: $8-12 USD/hour (DOE), paid bi-weekly via Wise or PayPal

Status: Independent contractor

Time zone: Must overlap with US Pacific Time by at least 2 hours during the workday



About us



We're a small operation running several interconnected businesses — a Shopify merchandise platform serving a community of YouTube creators, a high-traffic educational web property, and a few other ventures in adjacent creative spaces. We don't operate like a corporate org. We operate like a workshop: a small number of people, a lot of moving parts, and a strong preference for systems that hold the chaos rather than people memorizing it.



We're hiring someone to be the person who sees the whole picture across the workshop — not to do every task, but to make sure no important thread gets dropped between the people who handle the threads.



What you'll do



- Own 
 as the source of truth. Maintain boards across product launches, creator releases, customer support trends, and operational projects. If it's not on the board, it doesn't exist.

- Maintain the creator release calendar. We work with multiple YouTube creators whose launch dates drive everything downstream (production, shipping, marketing). The calendar needs to be accurate, current, and visible to the right people.

- Produce a weekly status note — short, plain-language, no fluff — that synthesizes what's moving across the businesses, what's stuck, and what needs the owner's attention this week. Think of it as a 5-minute read on Monday morning.

- Coordinate handoffs between the customer support contractor, the factory liaison (handled by an existing partner), and the owner. Not "send the
 for them" — make sure the right person has the right context to do their part.

- Spot drift. If a project hasn't moved in two weeks, ask why. If two people are doing the same thing, raise it. If a launch date is at risk, flag it before it slips.



This role has no access to payment systems, refund authority, or financial accounts. It is a coordination and synthesis role. You'll see what's happening; you won't be moving money.



What we're looking for



- 3+ years of project management or operations experience, ideally for small businesses, agencies, creator-economy companies, or e-commerce brands. Big-company PMO experience is fine but not what we're hiring for.

- Demonstrated comfort with 
 (or a clear track record with similar tools — ClickUp, Notion, Asana — and willingness to standardize on Monday).

- Clear, concise written English. Your weekly status notes are a deliverable, not an afterthought. We'll read them carefully.

- A synthesis instinct. The hard part of this job isn't tracking tasks — software does that. The hard part is noticing the pattern across tasks: "three different creators are blocked on the same factory," or "we keep promising launch dates we don't hit by the same number of days." We want someone who notices.

- Independence. We don't have time to give you daily direction. You should be the kind of person who reads the state of things, d
 what matters, and brings us the three questions worth answering this week.



Bonus, not required



- Experience supporting YouTube creators, Twitch streamers, or other digital-native creative principals

- Experience with Shopify-based merchandise businesses

- Background working across multiple time zones (Philippines, US, China)



How to apply



Send a short message — not a formal cover letter — answering these three things:



1. Describe a time you noticed a problem that nobody had asked you to look for. What was the pattern, how did you spot it, and what did you do about it?

2. Imagine you've just been hired and it's the end of your first week. What would you have done with those 5 hours, and what would your first weekly status note look like? (No need to be exhaustive — a sketch is fine.)

3. Include the phrase "red kite at sunrise" somewhere in your message so I know you read this whole posting.



Applications without all three will not be reviewed. I read every reply personally.

title: Accounting Generalist
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Accounting Generalist to join our Finance Operations team. This role ensures that financial processes are executed efficiently, accurately, and in alignment with departmental goals. 

The Accounting Generalist will manage a variety of accounting tasks, including expense processing, time sheet verification, and invoice organization. The position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to handle multiple workflows across billing, vendor management, compliance, and reporting. 

You will collaborate closely with internal teams, consultants, and vendors to maintain smooth financial operations and meet deadlines. Additionally, you will coordinate with internal departments to gather necessary information and ensure compliance with established accounting policies and procedures. 

 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

Timekeeping & Payroll Support 

• Validate and enter employee hours into the payroll system for accurate and timely processing. 

• Maintain detailed records of payroll earnings, deductions, and adjustments for compliance. 

• Organize and distribute payroll reports while ensuring confidentiality. 

• ADP Maintenance 

• Collect consultant hours and vendor invoices for processing. 

• Manage approval of workflows for timesheets and expenses. 

• Maintain vendor profiles and contact information. 

• Assist in 1099 preparation and year-end reporting. 

• Download and save ADP Workforce Now & Deel reports. 

• Manage HSA administration through Optum as needed. 

State Tax Notice Support 

• Monitor and track incoming state tax notices. 

• Maintain organized records for audit and compliance. 

• Monitor Smart Compliance reports for Tax IDs and filing compliance. 

• Assist with WA L&I quarterly filings and other state-level requirements. 

Accounts Payable Support 

• Maintain and update vendor management system (VMS) and folders for accurate payment validation. 

• Add vendor bills to accounting software and shared drives. 

Software Maintenance 

• Maintain organized documentation for audits and compliance. 

• Support data entry and validation for accuracy in financial systems. 

Accounts Receivable Support 

• Finalize expense reports and upload them to Salesforce. 

• Validate data in Fieldglass for compliance. 

• Review contracts for billing terms and conditions. 

• Prepare and update billing schedules, breakdowns, and reconciliations. 

• Reconcile incoming payments and maintain payment update reports. 

• Perform overdue follow-ups with vendors or internal teams. 

Other Tasks 

• Assist in day-to-day accounting operations and data entry. 

• Ensure adherence to company policies, GAAP/IFRS standards, and regulatory requirements. 

• Organize financial documents in OneDrive and applicable software. 

• Handle problem-solving, research, and employee inquiries. 

• Perform additional tasks as assigned. 

 

POSITION TYPE / EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK 

Full-time, Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. EST. Occasional long hours and weekend work may be required. 

  Key Qualifications: 

• Proficiency in accounting software, spreadsheets, and standard office tools. 

• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities. 

• Accuracy and attention to detail in all financial processes. 

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working across multiple functions to support operational success. 



EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE 

• Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or equivalent. 

• Minimum of 1 year of experience in an accounting environment. 

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel required). 

• Experience with accounting and payroll tools such as ADP, Deel, QuickBooks, Salesforce, Harvest, Ramp, Fieldglass, etc. 

 

SKILLS & QUALITIES 

• Communication: Clear, concise business English for reports and correspondence. 

• Resilience: Ability to manage changing priorities and heavy workloads. 

• Decision-Making: Strong judgment and problem-solving skills. 

• Interpersonal Skills: Comfortable working with diverse internal and external stakeholders. 

• Organizational Skills: Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively. 

• Teamwork: Collaborative approach to achieving departmental goals. 

• Process-Oriented: Adherence to established systems and compliance standards. 

• Attention to Detail: Essential for accuracy and meeting deadlines. 

 

WORK ENVIRONMENT / TRAVEL 

Remote work model using standard office equipment. No travel is required. A background check is required. 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS 

Occasionally standing, walking, sitting, and lifting to 20 pounds.

-Offer scheduling options based on the 3-day call board, same-day availability (if down), or estimate availability.



-Coordinate with dispatch for same-day bookings or priority situations.



-Communicate cancellation policies and provide accurate service expectations.



5. Outbound Calls & Follow-Up



-Return missed calls and respond to voi
s within 30 minutes (1 hour max).



-Confirm, reschedule, or follow up on upcoming appointments.



-Conduct outbound campaigns for:



-Tune-ups



-Plumbing inspections



-Electrical inspections



-Meet minimum outbound calling goals set by management.



-Contact customers on “hold” status and bring them back on the schedule.



-Create and verify outbound calling lists.



6. Home Depot Lead Management



-Accept and process incoming Home Depot leads inside ServiceTitan’s booking tab.



-Enter leads into tracking spreadsheets and create profiles ensuring the F-number and tags are accurate.



-Immediately call the lead—if no answer, leave voi
 and send a text.



-Update lead tracking sheets and the Home Depot Service Center with correct outcomes.



-Schedule jobs for customers who convert and ensure both systems are updated.



-Complete a structured follow-up process (Day 2, 4, 6, 7) before dismissing unresponsive leads.



-Record every contact attempt in both the tracker and Home Depot Service Center.



7. CRM & Documentation



-Log all customer interactions accurately in ServiceTitan and/or Slack.



-Maintain up-to-date records including service notes, history, equipment, and contact information.



-Tag opportunities, flag priority issues, and escalate leads for management review.



8. Customer Issue Resolution



-Address customer concerns, service delays, or complaints with empathy and professionalism.



-Document issues and updates in Slack and ServiceTitan.



-Escalate concerns when needed to managers or service leadership.



-Track ongoing issues and provide customers with timely follow-ups.



9. Internal Communication



-Communicate job updates, cancellations, urgent customer needs, or scheduling issues to dispatch and office staff in Slack.



-Participate in morning huddles or team briefings when required.



-Share technical issues, customer feedback, or system concerns promptly with management.



10. General Administrative Support



-Assist with
ing invoices, estimates, receipts, or documentation to customers.



-Monitor and respond to support inbox inquiries (Yelp, Thumbtack, Chiirp, Contractor Commerce, FPL, BBB, Brita Pro, and others) within 30 minutes–1 hour.



-Support marketing campaigns by completing outbound call lists or follow-up tasks.



-Assist in managing customer reviews (Google,
, etc.) and reputation initiatives.



11. End-of-Day Wrap-Up



-Review daily call logs and ensure all documentation is complete and accurate.



-Flag unresolved issues or follow-ups for next-day attention.



-Communicate urgent matters to the on-call or after-hours team.



12. Data Entry & System Updates (ServiceTitan)



-Add and update customer equipment details (brand, model, serial number, age).



-Apply appropriate job, customer, and location tags throughout the CRM.



-Ensure all data is accurate, consistent, and properly categorized.



Qualifications



-Previous experience in customer service, HVAC/plumbing/electrical scheduling, or call center preferred.



-Strong communication and active listening skills.



-Ability to remain calm and empathetic in high-volume or emergency situations.



-Proficiency with CRM software (ServiceTitan preferred but not required).



-Strong multitasking and organizational abilities.



-Reliable internet connection, quiet workspace, and ability to work remote full-time.

title: Short-Form Clip Strategist & Editor for Dr. Jones' Team
description:
Here’s the cleaned-up spacing/indentation version: 



---



?? **Two non-negotiables. Read before applying:**



1. You must have a proven track record of working Mountain Time hours, 8 AM–5 PM Denver, Colorado, Monday through Friday.

   Not “willing to try.” Not “flexible.” A real history of working these hours consistently. If you can’t show that, don’t apply.



2. You must have strong English speaking and comprehension skills.

   You’ll be watching hours of spoken English content, parsing nuance, writing captions, and communicating with our team daily. Weak English means missed clips and wasted footage. If your English isn’t strong, this role isn’t for you.



---



Dr. Jones’ team is hiring a **Short-Form Clip Strategist & Editor** to repurpose our long-form content — YouTube videos, livestreams, and coaching call replays — into high-performing short-form videos for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and
 Reels.



This is not a standard editing role.



You won’t receive pre-selected clips or finished briefs. You’ll watch full long-form replays, d
 what becomes a short, and build it.



The hardest and most valuable part of this job is finding the clip — recognizing the 
nt that will stop a scroll. Editing the clip is the easy part.



If you’ve ever used AI clip tools like Opus, you know they hit maybe 2 out of every 10 clips. We need a human who consistently finds the other 8.



---



**What You’ll Actually Do**



* Watch 40–90 minute YouTube videos, livestreams, and coaching call replays

* Identify the strongest clip opportunities — strong hooks, curiosity gaps, surprising or contrarian 
nts, emotionally resonant beats

* Cut and edit those clips into standalone short-form videos that make sense to a viewer who’s never seen the source

* Construct hooks creatively — pull a hook line from one 
nt and stitch it onto a different clip body, combine clips, write or reorder text overlays, do whatever it takes to make the hook land in the first 2 seconds

* Add captions, on-screen text, light graphics, zooms, pattern interrupts, and sound design

* Write the caption and hashtags for each post

* Post directly to TikTok and YouTube Shorts if assigned

* Prepare Instagram Reels for handoff to our US-based poster

* Take ownership of the TikTok page over time — track what’s working, propose adjustments, help us grow



Some clips may need a 10–15 second hook re-shoot from Dr. Jones. If that’s what makes the clip work, ask — he’s open to it.



The goal is to save him time and squeeze every drop of value out of long-form content that’s already been recorded.



---



**What We’re Looking For**



* **Mountain Time availability with a verifiable history — non-negotiable.**

  8 AM–5 PM MT, Monday through Friday.



* **Strong English speaking and comprehension — non-negotiable.**

  You’ll be parsing spoken nuance, sarcasm, emphasis, and clinical language across hours of footage.



* **Clip-hunting taste — non-negotiable.**

  You can articulate why a 
nt will perform: the hook structure, the curiosity gap, the emotional beat, the contrarian frame. You can also articulate why a 
nt won’t perform, even if it sounds good in the room.



* **Editorial creativity.**

  You don’t just cut what’s there. You restructure, frankenstein hooks onto bodies, layer clips, and rebuild 
nts to make them stronger than they were in the original.



* Strong short-form editing fundamentals: hooks, pacing, retention, captions, on-screen text, visual emphasis, sound design, pattern interrupts



* Independent operator. You don’t need step-by-step direction. You watch the footage, d
 what to make, make it, post it, and report back.



* Caption and hashtag writing skills. You write the post copy yourself.



* Discretion and confidentiality. Some source footage is from private coaching calls. You’ll handle it professionally and never share, repurpose, or reference it outside our workflow.



---



**Bonus Skills**



* Background in healthcare, fitness, wellness, GLP-1, weight loss, or functional medicine content

* Motion graphics, sound mixing, color correction

* Experience growing a TikTok or YouTube Shorts page from scratch

* Ability to identify long-form videos with the highest clip yield before watching them in full

* Cover frame / thumbnail design



You don’t need to be a health expert on day one. We have an AI tutor system that will get you up to speed on the subject matter, terminology, and what makes our content valuable.



---



**Technical Requirements**



* Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro — not CapCut

* High-performance editing computer with reliable, high-speed internet

* Mobile device for Slack, Trello, and posting workflows

* Fluency with project management and communication apps, specifically:



  * Trello — project management, you’ll live in this daily

  * Slack — team communication, primary channel

  * Google Drive — file workflows

  * 
 — review/approval

* Ability to export properly formatted vertical video for every major platform



---



**Availability**



* Full-time, 40 hours/week

* 8 AM–5 PM Mountain Time, Monday–Friday

* Verifiable history of working these hours required

* 100% remote



---



**Compensation**



$6–$8/hour, with flexibility above that range for an exceptional portfolio and demonstrated clip-hunting taste.



---



**How to Apply**



 the following to 



* Updated CV or resume

* Confirmation that you can work 8 AM–5 PM Mountain Time consistently, plus a brief note on your history doing so, including current/past roles and hours worked

* Portfolio of short-form vertical videos you’ve edited



  * Repurposed clips from livestreams, podcasts, coaching calls, or webinars are strongly preferred over scripted talking-head edits

* A short paragraph on your experience repurposing long-form or live content

* Any background in educational, healthcare, fitness, or wellness content

* A short explanation of how you d
 whether a 
nt from a long-form video is strong enough to become a short



  * This is the most important part of your application



---



**Trial Clip**



We’ll send shortlisted applicants a 60-minute replay. You’ll send back 3 clips you’d cut and a 1–2 sentence explanation of why each one.



This is how we evaluate taste.



Optional but encouraged: tell us how you’d approach turning a 60-minute livestream into multiple potential shorts.



---



Apply only if you can work Mountain Time hours, have strong English skills, and can independently source strong 
nts from long-form replays, build them into standalone shorts, write the captions, and post — without heavy supervision.
