title: Creative Branding Coordinator
description:
This is not a typical creative role



Claim Factory is an AI-powered auto damage appraisal platform. We are lean, systematized, and built differently than every other firm in this industry — and nobody knows it yet. That's the problem you're solving.



We are starting from zero. No logo. No website. No content library. No brand voice. Just an LLC, a superior product, and a founder who knows exactly what this industry is missing and is ready to say it out loud.



We need someone who can look at a blank canvas and see something. Someone who understands that brand is not just aesthetics — it's the story people tell about you when you're not in the room. Your job is to make sure that story is the right one, told consistently, across every surface Claim Factory touches.



You will have full creative autonomy. The founder will approve the vision — then you run it.



What you'll build



Phase 1 — Brand identity



Logo, color palette, typography, and visual system  ·  Brand voice guide — how we sound in every context  ·  Core messaging framework — what we say and what we never say  ·  Brand standards document that the entire team operates from



Phase 2 — Digital presence



Website — clean, simple, linked to our operating system (appraiser portal, client claim management, employee application)  ·  
pany page and founder presence  ·  Instagram and broader social presence built for industry authority, not vanity metrics



Phase 3 — Ongoing content engine



Consistent content across platforms that tells our story, educates the market, and builds trust with carriers, appraisers, and policyholders  ·  Content calendar, publishing cadence, and performance tracking  ·  Creative assets for sales, onboarding, and operations as the company scales



Who you are



You think in stories — not just posts, not just logos, but narratives that build over time

You have strong design instincts and can execute them, not just describe them

You understand B2B brand building — you know the difference between building authority and chasing likes

You can write — clearly, compellingly, and in a voice that isn't generic

You are self-directed — you don't wait to be told what to post next week

You are hungry — you want to build something you can point to and say you made that

You are consistent — brand authority is built in years, not campaigns

Tools & platforms in scope



Figma or equivalent

Canva (advanced)

LinkedIn

Instagram

Website (no-code or light dev)

Adobe Creative Suite (nice to have)

Content scheduling tools

Loom or video editing basics

What we are not looking for



We are not looking for someone to post generic content on a schedule. We are not looking for someone to copy what every other IA firm does — "we have appraisers everywhere and our portal accepts your file." That is the industry floor, not the ceiling.



Claim Factory's process is our product. Our transparency is our differentiator. Our story has never been told. We need someone who gets that and can translate it into a brand that makes carriers, appraisers, and policyholders feel like they found something different — because they did.

title: Short-Term Rental Operations Manager (Senior Level)
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines-based applicants only)

Work Schedule: Full-time, Thursday to Monday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM EST (or until the last guest checks in, whichever is later)

Salary: Negotiable, based on experience (with performance-based bonuses and uncapped independent direct booking commissions for good work)



About the Company

We are a privately held U.S. hospitality operator with a curated portfolio of design-forward vacation rentals across multiple regions. The founder runs the portfolio as a long-term asset rather than a churn-and-burn operation. The team values radical accountability, proactive decision-making, and treating every property as if it were your own.



About the Role

We are hiring a senior, experienced Short-Term Rental Operations Manager to run day-to-day operations across a growing multi-property portfolio. You will act as the "owner" of your assigned homes, owning guest experience, vendor performance, listing quality, and the review pipeline across Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, and direct channels.

This is not a ticket-closing role and this is not a virtual assistant position. We want someone who identifies what is broken, proposes the fix, and drives it to completion. If you have less than 5 years of hands-on STR operations experience, this role is not for you.



Operations and Guest Experience



Run daily operations across the portfolio with full ownership of outcomes

Manage guest messaging across all channels, stepping in personally when issues require human judgment or recovery

Handle escalations end-to-end: access issues, cleanliness complaints, maintenance emergencies, refund and resolution negotiations

Own pre-arrival, in-stay, and post-stay touchpoints with an eye toward 5-star reviews as the default, not the exception



Review and Reputation Management



Own the review pipeline: monitor incoming reviews daily, respond professionally to public reviews, and proactively request reviews from satisfied guests

Identify patterns in negative or neutral reviews and drive operational changes to eliminate root causes

Track review score trends by property and escalate declining performance with a proposed remediation plan

Handle dispute cases, Airbnb Resolution Center claims, and damage recovery



Vendor and Cleaner Coordination



Coordinate cleaners, handymen, landscapers, pool techs, and other vendors across properties

Review turnover checklists and photo documentation to enforce quality standards

Source, vet, and compare vendor quotes when replacements or new trades are needed

Make cost-conscious decisions that protect cash flow without compromising guest experience



Listing Management



Create, launch, and maintain listings across Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, and direct booking channels

Keep photos, amenities, descriptions, house rules, and pricing levers accurate and optimized

Coordinate listing refreshes when properties are updated or seasonality shifts



KPIs and Process Optimization



Monitor the KPIs that actually matter: review scores, response time, cleaner turnover quality, occupancy, ADR, and resolution rates

Use existing SOPs as a starting point and actively propose improvements. We expect this role to make the operation better over time, not just keep it running.

Build and refine playbooks for recurring scenarios (same-day bookings, maintenance triage, guest escalations, damage claims)

Flag blind spots and inefficiencies to leadership with a recommended fix, not just a problem statement





Pricing and Revenue Management

You will not be handling pricing or revenue management directly. We have a dedicated revenue manager for that. However, you must be knowledgeable about dynamic pricing concepts, occupancy optimization, ADR, and RevPAR. You should be able to read performance reports, flag anomalies, and have informed conversations about property performance.



Requirements (Non-Negotiable)



5+ years of hands-on STR property management experience with full operational ownership. This is a senior-level hire. We are not looking for coordinators or virtual assistants. You must have owned operations, not just supported them.

Proficiency in Guesty is required. You must have real, hands-on working experience using Guesty as your PMS. Familiarity with other PMS platforms (Hospitable, Hostaway) is a plus, but Guesty experience is a must.

Experience with all major OTAs: Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, and direct booking channels

Demonstrated track record handling escalations, negotiating resolutions, and making independent judgment calls under pressure

Strong written English with a professional and empathetic guest communication style

Owner mentality. Organized, proactive, and willing to make the call when leadership is not available.





Work Schedule and After-Hours Availability (Read This Carefully)

Your regular working hours are Thursday to Monday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM EST or until the last guest checks in for the day, whichever is later. This schedule is strict and non-negotiable. You must be fully available and working during these hours. If a guest is checking in at 8:00 PM, 9:00 PM, or later, you are expected to be available until that guest is settled.

After-hours emergency availability is required. This role owns guest communication. Emergencies in short-term rentals do not wait for business hours. Guest lockouts, urgent maintenance, safety concerns, and other time-sensitive issues can and will happen outside your regular shift. You must be reachable and responsive via mobile for true emergencies during off-hours, including Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

This is not optional. If you are not comfortable being on-call for emergencies outside your regular schedule, please do not apply.

Background Check

All candidates who move forward in the hiring process must be open to a background check. This is standard for our team and non-negotiable.

Time Tracking

We use a time tracking tool during working hours. To be clear, we are not going to babysit your screen or micromanage your day. We trust our team. title: 24 HR Review | VA Remote Virtual Receptionist
description:

We are currently seeking a Remote Spa Receptionist. This role consists of handling inbound calls, booking appointments, and completing various administrative tasks. Continued placement depends on accuracy, professionalism, booking success, reliable attendance, no missed calls during scheduled shifts, quick response times, and the ability to professionally manage complaints and de-escalate dissatisfied clients.

(1) Location & Utilities: Where in the Philippines are you currently located? How often have you experienced power or internet outages in the past year? Do you have backup solutions (e.g., generator, mobile hotspot) to ensure your work is not affected?



(2) Home Setup: Will you be working from home? Is your workspace quiet and suitable for handling calls? Do you have your own computer or laptop? Please attach a screenshot of your current internet speed.

Your tone should be calm, polite, and professional.

(8) Schedule, Pay & Start Date: Are you able to work seven days a week, six hours per day, during Central Standard Time (CST) hours without conflicts? What is your expected hourly or monthly rate? What is your earliest physical start date if hired?

 Reels or similar platforms? Please describe your skills and provide samples of your previous work if available.
